milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The soul lantern hangs from the ceiling at spawn-relative (0, 3, -3) above the corridor entrance. The player must be within 16 blocks and facing toward it, confirming they have visually located the landmark. max_distance=16 is appropriate because the soul lantern is visible from most of the main room (confirmed in sandbox step_005), and 'finding' means visually locating it. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the lantern.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cyan bed foot is at spawn-relative (0, 0, -7) in the back room behind the dividing wall (at z=-3/-4). max_distance=5 is deliberately tight to ensure the player has actually entered the back room through the corridor — from the main room side the player would be 4+ blocks away horizontally AND blocked by the wall, so this cannot be triggered without navigating through the corridor past the soul lantern. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the bed.
